id.description: The issue, by key such as ABC-12

project.description: The project's ticker. Default: the one linked to this session's folder

stage.description: A stage of the board, by name

description.description: What the work is, enough to pick it up without this session

labels.description: Labels. On update it replaces the list

assignees.description: User ids, or me. On update it replaces the list

due.description: Due date, RFC 3339. Empty clears it

query.description: With list: words of the title or description, or a key

mine.description: With list: only what is assigned to this user

on_external.description: With comment: post on the linked external issue

relation.description: With relate: how the issues relate

other.description: With relate: the other issue's key

remove.description: With relate: take the relation off

pr_url.description: With link: a pull request's URL

connection.description: With link: the connection the external issue is on

external_id.description: With link: the external issue's own id
